description: M10 LSM6DSO IMU (M9 assumptions); AS5047P on each RO40 rotor, so the joint angles include both belt deflections; AS5047P on each axle end reading the hub magnet, so the wheel angle is relative to the shin. Catalog INL is a deterministic periodic term, not quantization. Noise, bias, delay and filter values are the M9 assumptions.

parts.joint: AS5047P 14 bit on the RO40 rotor; 16384 counts per rotor revolution are 65536 per output revolution through the 4:1 belt. The output ranges (a1 60 deg, a2 54 deg) stay within one rotor turn, so the reading is absolute.
parts.wheel: AS5047P 14 bit on the fixed axle end, reading a 6 x 1 mm diametric magnet in the hub wall (m10.internals.hub): wheel angle relative to the shin.
parts.error_basis: AS5047P displaced/full-temperature INL bound 1.2 deg. Joint: divided by the 4:1 belt and modelled as sin(2 x output angle), so the amplitude is right but the rotor-side harmonic is not reproduced. Wheel: modelled as sin(angle). Transport 5 ms is a host assumption including device readout.
parts.fusion_basis: Phase C6: the velocity estimate is the IMU point's forward velocity, predicted with the horizontal specific force and corrected towards wheel odometry moved to the IMU point (innovation clipped at 0.05 m/s, so tire hops and airborne wheel spin cannot drag it). A second state estimates the forward accelerometer bias (sensor bias plus pitch error x g) with a 3 s time constant, so a constant bias leaves no steady velocity error.
